# TrackPH Microservice — Copilot Instructions

Spring Boot microservice for the TrackPH government project monitoring platform.

See [../../docs/dev-guide.md](../../docs/dev-guide.md) for architecture, conventions, auth, audit logging, Flyway rules, theme system, and anti-patterns.

Clone checklist: rename `ph.trackph.template` → `ph.trackph.<your-service>`, rename `TemplateApplication`, delete `Sample*` files, update `application.yml`.
